SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.CustomerID) 
FROM customers t1 
JOIN yearmonth t2 ON t1.CustomerID = t2.CustomerID 
WHERE t1.Currency = 'euro' AND t2.Consumption > 1000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.CustomerID) 
FROM transactions_1k AS t1 
JOIN yearmonth AS t2 ON t1.CustomerID = t2.CustomerID 
JOIN customers AS t3 ON t1.CustomerID = t3.CustomerID 
WHERE t3.Currency = 'Euro' AND t2.Consumption > 1000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.CustomerID) FROM transactions_1k AS t1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS t2 ON t1.CustomerID = t2.CustomerID INNER JOIN customers AS t3 ON t1.CustomerID = t3.CustomerID WHERE t3.Currency = 'Euro' AND t2.Consumption > 1000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) 
FROM customers c 
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID 
WHERE c.Currency = 'Euro' AND y.Consumption > 1000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) 
FROM customers c 
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID 
WHERE c.Currency = 'Euro' AND y.Consumption > 1000
